# Spine 4.3 binary parser fixture

`spineboy-pro.skel` and `spineboy.atlas` are copied from the official
Esoteric Software `spine-runtimes` repository, branch `4.3`, path
`examples/spineboy/export/`.

Source: https://github.com/EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes/tree/4.3/examples/spineboy/export

These files are test-only and remain governed by the Spine Runtimes License.
The repository license explicitly permits evaluating the provided runtime
examples. They are not included in generated games or release packages.
